description: List transactions currently pending in the daemon's mempool (not yet in a block), optionally filtered by `publicKey`. Each entry has top-level `from`/`to` (B62q… pubkeys) plus `amount`/`fee`/`nonce`/`hash`/`kind`/`memo`/`failureReason`. Empty once everything has been included — does not show mined txs.
name: get_mempool
